section.div: CortexOps is a cloud-native platform for managing the complete lifecycle of AI models and LLM services. It centralizes model discovery, governance, inference metering, multi-tenant quota enforcement, and fine-tuning lineage tracking, helping organizations deploy, monitor, and manage AI systems efficiently at scale.
Build autonomous AI workflows with multi-agent orchestration, intelligent routing, hybrid RAG, knowledge graphs, MCP tools, persistent memory, and human-in-the-loop execution.

Rconnectx is a futuristic, production-ready startup networking platform featuring real-time messaging, AI-driven feeds, and GitHub integration. Built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL.

Sepsis Detection System Developed a predictive machine learning model to detect the early onset of sepsis in hospitalized patients by analyzing real-time clinical data (vital signs, lab results, and demographics). By identifying subtle physiological changes hours before clinical manifestation, the system serves as an early-warning tool to trigger
